Name: Birthdays Reminder
Author: TrueYahir
Description:
[size=4][b]Birthdays Reminder [/b]is a lightweight, essential utility for Stardew Vallet, that sends a helpful HUD notification when you wake up, letting you know who's birthday is that day. Making it unnecessary to look at the calendar again to find out a birthday.[/size]

[list]
[*][size=4]The mod only notify you about birthdays for NPCs you have already met. If you haven't introduced yourself to a character , nothing will be shown.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]It works with the latest Stardew Valley 1.6 data structures.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]It's mod friendly, it should be work with custom NPC mods.[/size][/*]
[/list]

Si quieres ver más de mis proyectos, apóyame en [url=https://ko-fi.com/trueyahir]ko-fi.com/trueyahir[/url]
